PROJECTS 
Smart Citizen Assistant for Government Services GitHub 2026 
Tech Stack: React.js, FastAPI, Python, LangChain, ChromaDB, MongoDB, Groq LLM, Sentence Transformers 
Architected and implemented the complete backend intelligence for an AI -powered Smart Citizen Assistant by 
creating a domain -specific knowledge base from official government resources, preprocessing and embedding 
documents using Sentence Transformers, and implementing a Retrieval -Augmented Generation pipeline with 
ChromaDB, LangChain, and LangGraph. Integrated Groq LLM to generate grounded responses based on retrieved 
context, designed prompt templates to improve response quality, developed FastAPI services for inference and 
retrieval, and built a React.js frontend that enables citizens to access government service information through an 
intuitive conversational interface. 
AI-Powered Policy & Contract Decision Support System GitHub 2025 
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, React.js, Streamlit, LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB, Groq/OpenAI LLM, 
Sentence Transformers, OCR, PyMuPDF 
Developed a scalable AI -powered decision support platform designed to analyze large insurance policies and legal 
contracts using Retrieval -Augmented Generation (RAG). Implemented multi -format document ingestion, semantic 
chunking, embedding generation, and vector search to efficiently retrieve relevant information from lengthy 
documents. Integrated LLMs for clause extraction, policy interpretation, and structured JSON responses with 
supporting clause references, while building FastAPI backend services and an interactive React.js/Streamlit interface 
for real-time querying. 
School ERP Management System GitHub 2025 
Tech Stack: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Firebase Authentication 
Developed the backend architecture of a role -based School ERP system supporting dedicated portals for 
Administrators, Teachers, Students, and Parents. Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js and 
Express.js, integrated MongoDB for centralized data management, and implemented Firebase Authentication for 
secure role -based access. Built backend modules for student information management, attendance tracking, 
examination result processing, report card generation, fee management, and parent access to academic records, 
ensuring secure and efficient communication between the client and server. 
CERTIFICATIONS 
1. Completion Of C++ Training | IIT BOMBAY 2024 
2. Introduction To Machine Learning | AWS 2024 
3. Getting Started with Deep Learning | NVIDIA 2025

Secured 1st Place at the Institution Level on LeetCode, a Global Competitive Programming Platform 2025 
 Solved 250+ problems in LeetCode with Global Ranking of 67,674 | Max Rating - 1722

AI/ML : ML | Gen AI | LLMs | RAG | NLP | Prompt Engineering | Vector Embeddings 
Database : MongoDB | MySQL | ChromaDB 
Frameworks & Libraries : LangChain | FastAPI | Scikit-learn | Sentence Transformers | Pandas | NumPy
